name: What types of faucets can you repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of faucets can you repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our skilled plumbers are experienced in repairing a wide range of faucet types commonly found in homes. This includes compression faucets, cartridge faucets, ceramic disc faucets, and ball faucets. Whether your leak is in a kitchen, bathroom, or outdoor faucet, we have the expertise to diagnose the issue and provide an effective repair. We work with various brands and models to ensure your plumbing system functions correctly.
acceptedAnswer.description: We repair all common faucet types including compression, cartridge, ceramic disc, and ball faucets.
